items.label: Health first
items.action: Renal scan is on today’s calendar. Be hydrated before the appointment and do not let meetings crowd it out.

items.label: No stale-loop hiding
items.action: Open loops remain visible until explicitly closed: health appointment, DealersLink execution leverage, AI workflow buildout, and daily follow-through.

items.label: One measurable work output
items.action: Before noon, define one concrete deliverable that improves sales, inventory/pricing visibility, or your AI operating system. Ship or schedule the next action.

ai_fluency_drill.why_it_matters: A useful business agent is not just a chatbot. It can choose tools, read source data, take bounded actions, and report evidence. This is the bridge from AI answers to repeatable workflows.
ai_fluency_drill.practical_example: A sales-ops agent could read CRM notes, inventory/pricing data, and recent dealer activity, then draft the next-best outreach plan while clearly separating facts from recommendations.
ai_fluency_drill.tiny_try: Write one workflow as: trigger → data sources → allowed tools → forbidden actions → human approval point → success metric.

items.label: DealersLink / auto retail SaaS
items.signal: America's EV graveyard grows: The electric cars axed by automakers this year - Business Insider
items.application: Translate vendor/product movement into a question: what dealer task is still manual, slow, or poorly measured, and can DealersLink make that workflow simpler?

items.label: Sales leverage
items.application: Convert model/tooling news into better rep behavior: account research, objection prep, follow-up sequencing, CRM hygiene, and manager coaching loops.

items.label: Future AI business
items.signal: US says two military personnel killed by Iranian attack in Jordan - Reuters
items.application: Favor narrow, paid workflow wedges: a recurring report, an agent that saves a team 30 minutes daily, or an integration that turns messy inbox/CRM data into decisions.

items.label: Crypto / AI intersection
items.application: Only pursue if it creates real business utility: payments, identity, auditability, data rights, or agent-to-agent transaction rails. Ignore low-signal speculation.

ai_agents_radar.title: AI / Agents Practical Radar
items: Practical business use cases: prioritize automations that reduce CRM/admin drag or improve sales follow-through.
Agent tooling / MCP: watch for connectors that safely expose Gmail, Calendar, CRM, docs, and inventory systems to agents with audit trails.
Coding agents: use them for prototypes, internal tools, data cleanup scripts, and workflow dashboards; require review before production changes.
Sales / CRM automation: highest-value wedge is evidence-based next action, not generic email generation.
Model releases, startups, and tutorials: test against a real workflow benchmark. If it cannot save time or improve quality this week, park it.

process_improvement_radar.title: Process-Improvement Radar
items: Personal workflow: keep one trusted open-loop list. Review it daily and close, delegate, schedule, or deliberately defer each item.
DealersLink workflow: look for handoffs where data is retyped, copied from email, or explained repeatedly in meetings.
Sales process: standardize pre-call prep and post-call follow-up into reusable prompts/checklists tied to CRM fields.
AI operating system: every useful prompt should become a named workflow with inputs, outputs, and a quality bar.
